changes: Bounded persistent-command wait timeout returns a trusted live terminal/entry handle; the agent follows the original command through wait_shell instead of treating the whole role as cancelled.
Only unique exact command/resource/origin-session/runtime-dispatch provenance plus a terminal completion status and non-null exit code can reconcile a legacy unknown operation.
Known live handles bind reconciliation to the exact terminal entry; actual transport errors without handles remain unknown.

new_task checks unfinished tasks before handoff; explicit restart_task atomically retains/cancels a paused read-only task and creates the same-goal/scope investigation without bypassing unresolved operations.
Same-session specialists on the same SSH host/configuration/fingerprint share one human trust decision.

validation.restart: atomic rollback on unresolved operation, preserved goal/scope/history, idempotency, end-to-end model handoff plan-only creation passed
validation.hostTrust: parallel accept and reject both wake all peers; no authentication during fingerprint probe

liveReadOnlyAudit.memoryTask: paused, original command succeeded with runtime provenance, no unresolved operations

limits: A command exit code does not complete the specialist report or verify business recovery. The existing investigation remains paused until the user continues it.
True transport failures, incomplete terminal records and ambiguous matches are not automatically resolved.
Host identity confirmation remains a human decision.
